name: uswds-ai-components
description: USWDS 3.13.0 component registry with AI agent adaptation metadata. 146 accessible, mobile-friendly government website components.

conventions.selfContained: Each component is a single .html file demonstrating USWDS markup with embedded adaptation metadata.
conventions.tiles: infinite/<component-name>/<variant>.html — one variant per file, demonstrates component with USWDS classes, embedded uswds-agent-meta block
conventions.adaptationMetadata: infinite/<component-name>/<variant>.html contains <script type='application/json' id='uswds-agent-meta'> with full agent guidance

componentSchema.uswdsComponentType: string — official USWDS component name (e.g., accordion, button, modal)
componentSchema.uswdsClass: string — primary CSS class (e.g., usa-accordion, usa-button)
componentSchema.uswdsVariant: string — variant modifier class (e.g., usa-accordion--bordered, usa-button--secondary)
componentSchema.variants: string[] — all available variant class names for this component
componentSchema.settings: string[] — USWDS Sass settings that affect this component
componentSchema.jsBehavior: string — description of JavaScript behavior if required/optional
componentSchema.section: string — USWDS section (forms, navigation, feedback, data-display, layout, utilities)
componentSchema.description: string — one-sentence description of what this component does
componentSchema.useWhen: string[] — contexts where this component is appropriate
componentSchema.avoidWhen: string[] — contexts where this component should not be used
componentSchema.agentPrompt: string — example AI adaptation instruction with actual USWDS class names
componentSchema.editableAreas: string[] — CSS custom property names or class variants that can be changed
componentSchema.preserveElements: string[] — markup patterns and ARIA attributes that must be preserved
componentSchema.knownLimitations: string[] — caveats about browser support or USWDS behavior
componentSchema.relatedComponents: string[] — USWDS components often used with this one
componentSchema.tokenOverrides: string[] — USWDS design tokens (color, spacing, etc.) commonly overridden for this component
